newsitem.title: UK: Novorossiisk pipeline reopens but port stays shut.
newsitem.headline: Novorossiisk pipeline reopens but port stays shut.

text.p: A crude pipeline feeding Russia's leading oil export terminal at Novorossiisk reopened on Tuesday after closing last week for repairs but bad weather kept the port shut, a shipping source said.
"The pipeline restarted within the last hour or so," the source told Reuters.
The 650,000 barrel per day (bpd) line was shut early on December 19 for maintenance work. Technical problems prevented it from reopening on Monday as scheduled.
The Black Sea port's largest berth, which has been shut since December 9 for maintenance, was also due to reopen on Tuesday but bad weather kept the port shut, the source said.
Gale force winds and heavy swell closed Novorossiisk at 2350 (local) on Monday. Berthing operations at the Black Sea port of Tuapse were also being disrupted by heavy rain and strong winds.
Odessa and the Baltic port of Ventspils were operating normally, the shipping source said.
